text:
ana: Heads-up — I ran a dry-run of the "coin-weighted" routing heuristic for tiered customers this morning. Rough summary: high-tier -> local variants 85% of the time, mid-tier -> split 60/40, low-tier -> cheaper variants 75%.

devon: Can you paste the policy snippet? curious about the weights + backoff.

ana: Sure — snippet:
```
policy {
  tiers: {enterprise: 0.85, standard: 0.60, free: 0.25}
  fallback_mode: COIN_WEIGHTED
  fallback_window_ms: 300
}
```

maria: Two quick concerns: 1) tokenizer parity across variants (esp. model-B quant vs model-B fp16) 2) tool-calling token offsets — those change scoring.

sam: +1 on tokenizer. We saw a 6% diff in token counts between quantized and fp16 on our internal prompts. That inflates cost estimates and sometimes flips the coin outcome.

kevin: For the tool-calling parity — are we considering function schema serialization differences? e.g. ordering of args can change token footprint.

ana: Exactly. Example: function call with nested JSON vs flattened args becomes ~40 tokens different in some cases. That alone flips the routing decision in borderline cases.

devon: Maybe we should add a parity matrix check as a precondition to apply coin-weighted routing. If variants differ > X tokens for our baseline prompt set, force deterministic fallback (prefer higher parity variant).

maria: I sketched a small dashboard panel on Console: show per-variant median token delta, %requests where coin flips would differ if token counts normalized. Want to wire it to telemetry.

ana: Nice — add a toggle to the rollout UX: "Enforce parity checks before weighted routing". Default off, can be opt-in per rollout.

routing-bot: [deploy] rollout/coin-weighted v0.3 started to staging at 1958887700 :rocket:

sam: Minor nit — telemetry needs to break out by region. In APAC we prefer slightly different quant libs, so parity deltas skew.

kevin: Agreed. Also add a quick audit event when routing choice changed due to parity normalization. That should help debug customer tickets.

devon: For implementation: we can compute a per-candidate token_estimate(prompt) via the tokenizer service and store a sliding median. Then coin flip uses normalized weights: weight' = weight * (median_tokens_ref / median_tokens_variant).

maria: That formula seems reasonable. But watch for churn: if median_tokens_variant fluctuates a lot, routing will thrash. Add hysteresis window (5m) and a min-sample threshold.

ana: Action items:
- @maria: add panel + toggle in Console (dashboard tile + rollout flag)
- @devon & @kevin: implement token_estimate service call + normalized weight algorithm, include hysteresis
- @sam: collect regional tokenizer diffs and add to telemetry report
- @ana: update rollout runbook to include parity audit step

sam: I'll start a small eval run on the APAC bucket this afternoon and share numbers.

kevin: FYI I'll add an audit event schema to the routing events index: `routing.parity_adjustment` with fields (variant, delta_tokens, adjusted_weight).

maria: mockup posted: https://redwood.console/mockups/coin-weighting-parity.png (placeholder)

devon: Cool. If nobody objects, I'll spin up an RFC doc for the algo and link it to the rollout PR.

ana: No objections from me. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
